t: Beer Valley Brewing Company -- Brewbound.com | Beer industry news, jobs, and events.
s: Beer Valley Brewing Company is a small, independent microbrewery located in Eastern Oregon. Founded in 2005 by brewer Pete Ricks, the brewery started production in Ontario, Oregon in the summer of 2007. Specializing in the production of strong ales, the brewery currently produces 7 brands year round, plus occasional seasonals.
